what: A held-out set for the evidence layer's sentence gate, written on 27 September 2026 after the gate's fixes and before running it, and not used to change the gate. Run once and reported as measured. 'expect' is the person's judgement: block (unsupported) or allow (faithful).

hosting.title: Where it runs
hosting.text: The proof of concept runs on a single Mac. The language models run through Ollama on the same machine, so no document text leaves it.

review.title: Governance review
review.text: Every record is approved by a person before Tibi uses it. The statement review compares 542 statements and flags conflicts for a person to decide.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.text: Role-based permissions and an audit export are planned for a real deployment. They are not part of the proof of concept.
